title: MaleTheme Solo #019 · 남 V자 보디빌더·라이트 스모키·뱀파이어 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a cherry-blossom avenue in full bloom with a pale paved path strewn with petals, a waist-high wooden fence, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Kenyan man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a calm gentle gaze, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at his neck and hanging open down his back, leaving the front of his body bare, and a minimal black satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold cowboy boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
